units.source_text: 记得有一回，依然是在繁忙的夏季里，旅馆老板的远房亲戚加代姑娘来帮忙。

en.t: I remember one time, still during the busy summer season, when Miss Kayo, a distant relative of the innkeeper, came to help out.

units.source_text: 入秋的头一天，空房渐渐多起来。

en.t: On the first day of autumn, the number of empty rooms gradually began to grow.

units.source_text: 仓吉每晚都同加代一起去逐间关闭客房的挡雨板。

en.t: Every night, Kurakichi went with Kayo from room to room, closing the rain shutters in the guest rooms.

units.source_text: 他们还曾在深夜里双双到河边去洗温泉澡。

en.t: They had also once gone together to the riverside late at night to bathe in the hot spring water.
